key_points: Vaxcyte's vaccine candidate targets same market as Merck's Vaxneuvance, posing competitive threat.
Pfizer's Prevnar franchise faces new challenger, indicating broader competitive pressure in pneumococcal vaccines.
Multiple institutions reduced holdings (Park National, Argent Capital, Rockland Trust, MassMutual).
JPMorgan raised price target for Merck, indicating some analyst optimism.
Merck's cancer vaccine trial exceeded expectations, though RBC downgraded stock.
